Euler extraction returned both signs; Part.Orientation used positive half-turn labels, including exact matrix controls. Preserve the transform without Euler reconstruction, and retain signed rotation or accumulated turns separately.
tested_behavior.limits: Matrix construction does not preserve signed-angle history or guarantee a negative displayed angle. Mixed-axis paths, interpolation direction and editor formatting were not established.
